title: azimuth
description:
Cell type annotation workflow using Azimuth reference mapping (Seurat RunAzimuth()).
Accepts either an H5MU file (`--input`) or a Seurat object (`--input_seurat`) as query.

For H5MU input, the modalities are split, the modality selected with `--modality` is converted
to a Seurat object and mapped onto the Azimuth reference, and the annotated modality is converted
back and merged with the other (untouched) modalities. For Seurat input, the selected assay is
annotated and converted to an H5MU file containing a single modality.

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Input dataset (query) arguments. Exactly one of `--input` or `--input_seurat` must be provided.

input.description: The input (query) data to be annotated

input_seurat.description: The input (query) data to be annotated

input_seurat_assay.description:
Name of the Seurat assay in `--input_seurat` to run the annotation on.
Only used with `--input_seurat`.

input_var_gene_names.description:
Column in .var (`--input`) or in the feature metadata of `--input_seurat_assay`
(`--input_seurat`) containing gene symbols

input_reference_gene_overlap.description:
Minimum number of genes that must overlap between the query and the
reference for the mapping to be performed.

output.help_text: Type: `file`, multiple: `False`, required, default: `"$id.$key.output.h5mu"`, direction: `output`, example: `"output.h5mu"`.

write_seurat.description: Whether to also write the annotated Seurat object to `--output_seurat`.

output_obs_predictions.description:
In which `.obs` slots to store the predicted cell labels.
If provided, `--annotation_levels` must be provided as well, and both must have the same length.
If empty, defaults to `azimuth_pred_<level>`, with "." in the level name replaced by "_".

output_obs_probability.description:
In which `.obs` slots to store the prediction scores.
If provided, `--annotation_levels` must be provided as well, and both must have the same length.
If empty, defaults to `azimuth_probability_<level>`, with "." in the level name replaced by "_".

output_obs_mapping_score.description: In which `.obs` slot to store the per-cell mapping score.

output_obsm_umap.description: In which `.obsm` slot to store the query embedding projected onto the reference UMAP.

output_obsm_integrated.description: In which `.obsm` slot to store the integrated (reference-projected) embedding.

output_modality_imputed_adt.description:
Name of the modality in which the imputed protein expression is stored when `--do_adt` is set.
Must not already exist in `--input`.

output_compression.description: The compression format to be used on the output h5mu object.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description:
Arguments controlling which Azimuth reference to map the query onto.
There is no training step: RunAzimuth() maps the query directly onto
the chosen reference's precomputed embeddings.

Name of a curated Azimuth reference, downloaded and installed
automatically on first use via SeuratData

custom_reference.description:
Path to a local directory containing a "ref.Rds" and "idx.annoy"
file pair for a custom reference, e.g

annotation_levels.description:
Which annotation levels (columns in the reference's metadata,
e.g

do_adt.description:
Whether to impute a protein (ADT) assay from the reference, if
the reference includes antibody-derived tag data

mapping arguments.title: Mapping arguments
mapping arguments.description: Lower-level arguments passed through to RunAzimuth().

k_weight.description: Number of neighbors to consider when weighting anchors during label/embedding transfer.

n_trees.description: Number of trees used when building the annoy index for neighbor search.

mapping_score_k.description: Number of neighbors used to compute the per-cell mapping score.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
